scenario: A code-review task on a billing service PR needs a minimal context pack with ordered reads, freshness validation, provenance tracking, and a next skill named for handoff.
prompt: build a minimal context pack for reviewing the billing service PR; list the smallest authoritative docs ordered durable-first, validate freshness, record provenance and budget, and name the next skill.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the task scope is reviewing a billing service PR and deciding whether to approve, request changes, or route to a specialist
the smallest authoritative docs include CONTEXT.md, AGENTS.md, code-review SKILL.md, and work-item format doc
reads are ordered durable repo context first, then task-specific evidence
freshness validation is mandatory; no doc with unknown staleness is included
provenance tracking is mandatory; every entry carries source path, freshness-checked-at, and integrity flag
grounding: .agents/skills/routing/context-pack/SKILL.md#Steps - identify task scope and docs, order reads, record freshness/provenance/budget, capture facts for next skill
.agents/skills/routing/context-pack/SKILL.md#Guardrails - minimal context only, freshness validation mandatory, provenance integrity mandatory, no artifact drafting, canonical source only

instructionFollowing.criterion: The task scope is stated and smallestAuthoritativeDocs lists only paths required to decide the next skill.

levels.4: task scope is stated and docs are minimal and decision-relevant
levels.2: task scope is vague or docs include unnecessary files
levels.0: no task scope or docs are listed

instructionFollowing.criterion: Reads are ordered durable-first with budget.readsUsed and budget.readsRemaining recorded and no duplicate reads.

levels.4: reads are ordered durable-first, budget is recorded, and no reads are duplicated
levels.2: ordering is mostly durable-first but budget or duplicates are issues
levels.0: no read ordering or budget recording

instructionFollowing.criterion: Every doc has freshness validated or is explicitly listed as stale; unknown integrity fails closed and is excluded.

levels.4: all docs are freshness-validated or explicitly stale; unknown integrity is excluded
levels.2: most docs are validated but some have unknown staleness

instructionFollowing.criterion: Provenance is recorded for every entry: sourceOfTruth, freshnessCheckedAt, and provenanceIntegrity flag.

levels.4: every doc carries source, timestamp, and integrity flag
levels.2: provenance is partially recorded for some entries

goalCompletion.criterion: nextSkill is named or the pack explicitly states no downstream skill applies.

levels.4: next skill is named or the absence of a downstream skill is explicitly stated
levels.2: next skill is implied but not clearly stated

goalCompletion.criterion: decisions, risks, and blockers are populated; the pack alone is sufficient for handoff without reopening the full repo.

levels.4: decisions, risks, and blockers are all populated and the pack suffices for handoff
levels.2: some decisions, risks, or blockers are missing
levels.0: no decisions, risks, or blockers are recorded

goalCompletion.criterion: No over-collection: every additional read beyond the minimum is justified by freshness, provenance, and budget.

levels.4: context is minimal and every read is justified
levels.2: context is mostly minimal with minor over-collection
levels.0: context is over-collected with no justification

goalCompletion.criterion: The structured context pack result is returned and validated; canonical .agents/skills/ is used as source of truth.

levels.4: context pack is returned, validated, and uses canonical skills as source of truth
levels.2: result is present but validation is skipped or compatibility view is used as source

check.note: the context pack artifact must contain all required top-level fields
contextPack must contain taskScope, docs, provenance, freshness, and budget
negative control: no compatibility-view symlinks as source and no unknown-staleness docs included

assertions.note: the context pack must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Is every doc freshness-validated or explicitly stale, with unknown integrity failing closed?

levels.pass: all docs are validated or explicitly stale; unknown integrity is excluded
levels.fail: docs with unknown staleness are included or no freshness check is done

check.criterion: Is provenance recorded for every entry with sourceOfTruth, freshnessCheckedAt, and provenanceIntegrity?

levels.pass: every entry carries source, timestamp, and integrity flag
levels.fail: provenance is missing or incomplete for one or more entries

check.criterion: Is context collection minimal with no over-collection beyond the minimum needed?

levels.pass: context is minimal and every read is justified
